description:
The scheme PAGW WRC WH stands for Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Gramin - Water Resource Conservation and Water Harvesting. 

It aims to enhance water conservation and promote sustainable water management practices in rural areas. 

The objective of the scheme is to ensure the availability of water resources for agricultural and domestic use. 

It also seeks to improve the quality of life for rural households by providing access to clean and adequate water. 

The benefits include the construction of water harvesting structures and the promotion of water conservation techniques. 

Eligible beneficiaries are rural households that require assistance in water resource management. 

The application process typically involves submitting a request through the local gram panchayat or designated government office. 

The timeline for implementation may vary based on local conditions and project requirements. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development in collaboration with state governments. 

Additional details may include community participation in planning and execution to ensure sustainability.
